title: Accelerite
description: Accelerite is about a alternate upgrade for diamond that is not like netherite.
body:
**Accelerite is about a alternate upgrade for diamond that is not like netherite.**  
Process of making accelerite: The first thing you need to get accelerite is crying obsidian. Then you need amethyst and iron nuggets to create the ingot like the following image. ![Accelerite ingot recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eb3838f2a0d95a955d76cfd43b4c491f00c1be48.png)

When making a Accelerite claymore or saber you will need blaze rods and accelerite ingots. The following images are how they are crafted.

Saber:

![Saber](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/301c04d3c2df4710469e23572897d92ac18ac8e1.png)

Claymore:

![Claymore](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e2893f27983a4ce20ea36f2a6de0d277dc5bbf5c.png)

Upgrades: 
There are two upgrade for the claymore in accelerite the first upgrade increases damage fom 12.5 attack damage to 13.5 attack damage, this upgrade requires a netherite ingot and a accelerite template. The second upgrade in creases the attack range  from 1.4 to 1.5, this upgrade requires a netherite block  along with a accelerite template to make.

Armor:
The Accelerite armor set has the same armor and knock back resistance as netherite but has the armor toughness of iron making it take more damage than netherite. The Accelerite armor gives speed II when the full armor set is worn.

Tools:
The tools are faster in mining and attack speed but do less damage compared to diamond or netherite.

Trims:
As of right now Accelerite armor is unable to be trimmed and the upgrade template will eventualy be atrim avalible for it.
